Choose an image to start.

FreqSSM-Lite: a small U-Net with a frequency-domain block and a Mamba-style selective scan (about 280K parameters), trained on CPU with NumPy. Test PSNR shown next to each model. The low-light model works best on dark photos; the SICE model is meant for images with mixed under- and over-exposure.
